name: Clif Bar Baking Co. of Indianapolis - Indianapolis IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open industrial-park facility. Street View (2024-07) shows the building set back behind an open grass lawn with no perimeter fence at the road and open driveway entrances - no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint. Open driveway with no control = truckGate false. truckGateCount set to 0.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No truck gate and no booth structure at any entrance - false.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Industrial-park entrance driveways are short, connecting directly to internal parking/yard with minimal stacking depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck dock bank on the E/SE building face with several trailers backed in (z19/z20 imagery); estimate ~14 doors, banded 10-25; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop/staging yard on the SW with trailers parked in angled rows (z20 imagery at 39.8880,-86.2421); ~12-16 trailers, banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.railServed: A through rail line runs along the east edge of the property behind a tree buffer, but no spur enters the building - the facility is NOT rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One main bakery building (~209,000 sq ft after expansion). Neighboring buildings (a Concentra clinic, an adjacent warehouse) are separate parcels, not part of the Clif Bar campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified; left low-confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Open driveway; outbound lane count not separately determinable.
